definitions.gloss: side dish, prepared food, deli food
definitions.explanation: Pre-made dishes sold at supermarkets or specialty stores.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{惣菜|そうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: To buy prepared food at the supermarket.

examples.japanese: {惣菜|そうざい}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}している→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧。
{惣菜|そうざい}⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.notes: Bread with fillings like curry, ham, etc.

notes:
{惣菜|そうざい} refers to ready-made side dishes and prepared foods sold at supermarkets and deli shops.

POLITE FORM:
お{惣菜|そうざい} (osouzai) — commonly used in everyday speech.

COMMON TYPES:
- ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧: simmered dishes
- ⟦{揚|あ}げ{物|もの}→揚げ物：04975_agemono⟧: fried foods
- ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧: salads
- ⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧: pickles

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}{屋|や}→惣菜屋：noentry⟧: deli shop
- ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}コーナー→惣菜コーナー：noentry⟧: deli section
- ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}パン→惣菜パン：noentry⟧: savory bread

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese supermarkets and department store basements (⟦{デパ地下|デパちか}→デパ地下：08828_depachika⟧) are known for their extensive {惣菜|そうざい} selections.
